author: blu
body: Proves Regrowth: graveyard recursion. "Return target card from your graveyard to your hand." compiles to ReturnFromGraveyard. Applying it moves the targeted card from the caster's graveyard to hand, and the AI targets the best card in the yard (highest mana value): with a 1-drop Bear and a 6-drop Dragon in the graveyard, it buys back the Dragon.
